sections.voiceover: Did you know Martha C. Nussbaum just won the 2026 John W. Kluge Prize?
b_roll: Library of Congress facade in Washington

sections.voiceover: The Library of Congress announced it on September 22. She claimed the 2026 John W. Kluge Prize. Did the University of Chicago appoint her as professor of law and ethics?
The Library of Congress awards the John W. Kluge Prize every other year.
Nussbaum holds the Ernst Freund chair at the University of Chicago. Martha C. Nussbaum shapes global human rights and ethics. The University of Chicago confirmed her appointment.
b_roll: Law school library books stacked high

sections.voiceover: She officially takes the 2026 Kluge Prize home this year.
